response.text: {"question":"Does this Part apply to a CRR firm for both regulated and certain unregulated activities carried out from its UK establishment, as well as for prudential activities performed anywhere, taking group activities into account?","answer":"Yes. The Part applies to a CRR firm for regulated activities, principal dealing in investments, ancillary activities, MiFID ancillary services, and unregulated activities in a prudential context when carried out from a UK establishment, and it also covers prudential activities wherever they occur, considering the activities of other group members.","answerable":true}
